# Adjudication Task — Chapter 2

## Korean source

```text
  1|＃2화
  2|
  3|
  4|
  5|찬 바람이 얼굴에 닿았다. 나는 어릴 적부터 추위를 많이 타는 체질이라 사시사철 창문을 닫고 산다. 그럼 누가 창문을 열었단 말인가?
  6|
  7|‘뻔하지.’
  8|
  9|성진호, 이 원수 같은 인간.
 10|
 11|투덜거리며 이불을 목 끝까지 끌어올렸다. 옆에 누운 여자가 작게 칭얼거렸다.
 12|
 13|“……어?”
 14|
 15|여자? 여자 누구?
 16|
 17|순간 잠이 확 깼다. 나는 기상나팔 소리를 들은 이등병처럼 벌떡 일어났다. 그리고 천천히 고개를 돌렸다.
 18|
 19|“타이렁러太冷了.”
 20|
 21|세상에. 두 번 놀랐다. 첫 번째, 지금 이 상황을 이해할 수 없어서, 두 번째, 옆에 누워 있는 여자가 너무 예뻐서.
 22|
 23|연신 알아들을 수 없는 말을 중얼거리면서 이불로 파고드는데, 정신이 없는 와중에도 가슴이 떨릴 정도로 아름답다.
 24|
 25|때마침 불어온 찬 바람이 아니었다면 한참을 넋 놓고 바라봤을 것이다.
 26|
 27|‘그런데 여기가 어디지?’
 28|
 29|주위를 둘러봤다. 은은하게 감도는 붉은 촛불. 이상하게 자극적인 향기와 이불로 벗은 몸을 가린 미녀.
 30|
 31|가 본 적은 없지만 어디선가 많이 들어 본 그곳.
 32|
 33|‘룸살롱?’
 34|
 35|아니, 근데 내가 왜 여기 있어?
 36|
 37|그저 어리둥절하다. 뭐가 어떻게 된 거지? 어제는 진호 형이랑 한잔하고 고시원에 있는 내 방으로 돌아왔는데.
 38|
 39|요란한 코골이 소리를 피해 캡슐로 들어간 것까지, 전날의 기억이 생생하다.
 40|
 41|‘꿈을 꾸고 있나?’
 42|
 43|팔뚝을 강하게 꼬집었다. 아프다. 꿈이 아니다.
 44|
 45|점점 미궁으로 빠지는 상황이다. 멍하니 주위를 둘러보던 나는 여자의 어깨를 잡고 흔들었다.
 46|
 47|“저, 저기요.”
 48|
 49|여자가 게슴츠레한 눈으로 나를 바라봤다. 검푸른색으로 반짝이는 눈동자에 가슴이 또 쿵쾅거린다.
 50|
 51|“누구세요?”
 52|
 53|“션머?”
 54|
 55|“아, 선미 씨구나. 그런데 제가 물어본 건 그 뜻이 아닌데……”
 56|
 57|“션머?”
 58|
 59|“예……?”
 60|
 61|“션머……?”
 62|
 63|뭐야, 이게.
 64|
 65|잠시 흐르는 적막 속에서 우리는 서로를 응시했다. 그리고 깨달았다. 이 여자, 한국인이 아니다.
 66|
 67|“혹시 중국인이세요? 아니면 필리핀?”
 68|
 69|“……짜이나오런마?”
 70|
 71|‘이건 뭐, 말이 안 통하네.’
 72|
 73|답답함에 뒤통수를 벅벅 긁은 나는 다음 순간 용수철처럼 튀어 올랐다.
 74|
 75|띠링.
 76|
 77|
 78|
 79|읽지 않은 메시지를 확인하시겠습니까?
 80|
 81|수락    /    거절
 82|
 83|
 84|
 85|어디선가 들려온 종소리.
 86|
 87|유령처럼 허공에 둥둥 떠 있는 네모난 창.
 88|
 89|어디서 튀어나왔는지, 그전에 왜 이런 게 보이는지 짐작도 가지 않는다. 소름이 쫙 끼쳤다.
 90|
 91|“시발, 뭐야 이거.”
 92|
 93|억지로 쥐어 짜낸 목소리와 함께 반사적으로 주먹을 뻗었다.
 94|
 95|주먹이 그대로 네모 창을 관통, 아니, 통과했다. 정확히는 [수락]이라는 단어를.
 96|
 97|띠링.
 98|
 99|
100|
101|- 오랫동안 응답이 없어 캐릭터를 랜덤 선택 합니다.
102|
103|- [무림]을 탐색 중…… 캐릭터, [진태경]으로 플레이를 시작합니다!
104|
105|- [무림]에 로그인했습니다.
106|
107|- 최초 접속 보상이 주어집니다.
108|
109|.
110|
111|.
112|
113|- 현재 사용 중인 플레이어의 언어를 변경할 수 있습니다. [통합 언어 팩]을 적용하시겠습니까?
114|
115|
116|
117|캐릭터? 무림? 로그인?
118|
119|“어? 어어?”
120|
121|
122|
123|- [통합 언어 팩]이 적용됩니다.
124|
125|
126|
127|“잠깐, 잠깐만!”
128|
129|그때 여자가 말했다.
130|
131|“진 공자. 어디 아파요?”
132|
133|정확한 한국어 발음이다. 나는 [통합 언어 팩]이 적용됐다는 네모 창과 여자를 번갈아 보다가 생각했다.
134|
135|뭐가 어떻게 돌아가는 거야?
136|
137|
138|
139|* * *
140|
141|
142|
143|월화(月華). 여자의 이름이다.
144|
145|희고 매끄러운 피부에 주먹만 한 얼굴. 오밀조밀한 이목구비에 눈은 얼마나 크고 맑은지, 연예인 뺨 칠 정도다.
146|
147|나는 다시 한번 감탄했다.
148|
149|‘그래픽 끝내준다.’
150|
151|대강의 상황 파악은 끝난 후였다. 몇 가지만 맞춰 보면 간단한 사실이었다.
152|
153|무림. 캐릭터. 로그인. 플레이. 내가 마지막으로 잠든 곳은 게임 캡슐. 그리고 결정적으로.
154|
155|
156|
157|메시지창을 여시겠습니까?
158|
159|수락    /    거절
160|
161|
162|
163|시스템창이 있다. 소리 내서 말해도 되고, 속으로 생각해도 된다. 머리를 긁는 것은 일종의 단축키다. 허공에 원하는 항목을 클릭하는 것도 가능하다.
164|
165|‘이건 볼수록 신기하네.’
166|
167|마지막으로 플레이한 게임과는 상당한 괴리감이 있지만, 이곳은 게임 안이다. 나는 지금 게임을 하고 있다.
168|
169|‘그런데 언제 로그인이 됐지?’
170|
171|선을 꽂아 뒀던 기억은 없는데. 전날의 기억을 떠올리려는 찰나, 월화가 불쑥 손을 내밀었다. 잡티 하나 없는 두 손에는 물이 가득 찬 대접이 들려 있다.
172|
173|“마셔요. 잠이 덜 깬 것 같은데.”
174|
175|‘인공지능도 끝내주네.’
176|
177|월화의 얼굴을 힐끔거리면서 물을 들이켰다. 그리고 깜짝 놀랐다.
178|
179|‘뭐야, 이거?’
180|
181|냉수를 삼킬 때 느껴지는 청량감. 식도를 타고 배 속까지 시원해지는 느낌. 팔뚝에 닭살이 돋을 정도로 생생하다.
182|
183|실사 그래픽에 NPC의 인공지능, 하다못해 냉수 한 모금을 마셔도 게임이라곤 믿기 힘들 정도였다.
184|
185|이야, 요즘 기술이 엄청나다는 소문은 들었지만 이 정도일 줄이야. 게임 폐인이 생기는 이유를 알겠다.
186|
187|‘이래서 가상현실, 가상현실 하는구나.’
188|
189|놀이공원에 온 유치원생처럼 입을 벌리고 주위를 둘러보는데, 어디선가 매캐한 연기가 피어올라 눈 앞을 가렸다.
190|
191|고개를 돌려보니 어느새 곰방대를 문 월화가 나를 물끄러미 바라보는 중이었다.
192|
193|“왜……요?”
194|
195|워낙 사람 같아서 나도 모르게 존댓말이 튀어나왔다. 물론 그녀가 엄청난 미인이라는 이유도 한몫했다.
196|
197|월화는 연기를 후, 내뿜으며 대답했다.
198|
199|“그냥. 보고 싶어서?”
200|
201|얘는 얼굴만 예쁜 줄 알았더니 분위기도 장난 아니구나.
202|
203|여고생들이 봤으면 언니를 외치며 쌍코피를 터뜨릴 정도의 포스다. 머리부터 발끝까지 딱 이렇게 쓰여 있다.
204|
205|‘팜므파탈.’
206|
207|캐릭터 컨셉 잘 잡았네. 월화만 보고 게임 시작하는 유저들도 꽤 있을 것 같다.
208|
209|“진 공자, 오늘 좀 이상한 거 알아요?”
210|
211|진 공자? 오글거리는 호칭이다. 하지만 나는 시치미를 뚝 뗐다. 뭐랄까, 조금은 이 상황을 즐기고 싶었다.
212|
213|‘게임이니까.’
214|
215|“뭐가요?”
216|
217|“전부 다? 실성한 것처럼 허공을 바라보질 않나, 갑자기 존댓말을 쓰질 않나. 도무지 종잡을 수가 없네.”
218|
219|월화가 말을 마친 순간이었다.
220|
221|띠링.
222|
223|
224|
225|- [튜토리얼 퀘스트]가 생성되었습니다.
226|
227|
228|
229|게임 진행 방식이 참신하다. 보통은 다짜고짜 ‘드디어 정신이 들었군.’으로 시작해서 튜토리얼 퀘스트를 줬던 것 같은데.
230|
231|이런 걸 자유도라고 하나?
232|
233|‘어…… 퀘스트 확인?’
234|
235|하면서도 이게 맞나 헷갈렸는데, 예의 효과음과 함께 곧바로 퀘스트창이 떴다.
236|
237|
238|
239|퀘스트
240|
241|
242|
243|[튜토리얼 - 1단계]
244|
245|이제 당신은 무림에서의 첫발을 내딛습니다.
246|
247|기본적인 정보를 수집하고 상황을 인지하십시오.
248|
249|
250|
251|등급 : 튜토리얼 (연계 퀘스트)
252|
253|제한 : 최초 접속자
254|
255|임무 : 정보 수집 (미완료)
256|
257|         상황 인지 (미완료)
258|
259|보상 : 단단한 무복 세트
260|
261|        캐릭터 상태창 활성화
262|
263|        인벤토리 기능 활성화
264|
265|        스킬창 기능 활성화
266|
267|        연계 퀘스트
268|
269|
270|
271|
272|
273|‘정보 파악, 상황 인지?’
274|
275|게임을 많이 해 본 건 아니지만 이런 퀘스트는 또 처음이다.
276|
277|보통은 토끼를 몇 마리 잡으라거나, 게임 인터페이스 사용법을 연습시키지 않나?
278|
279|어쨌건 시도는 해 봐야지.
280|
281|“나에 대해서 얼마나 알아요?”
282|
283|내가 생각해도 단도직입적인 질문이다. 담배 연기 너머로 웃고 있는 월화의 얼굴이 보였다.
284|
285|“재밌는 질문이네요. 소문 그대로라고 해야 하나?”
286|
287|“소문?”
288|
289|“공자도 익히 알고 있는 그런 이야기들이죠. 당사자 면전에 대고 말할 만큼 좋은 이야기는 아니지만.”
290|
291|“괜찮으니까 들어나 봅시다.”
292|
293|나는 점점 이 게임에 대해 흥미가 생기기 시작했다. 오랜만에 하는 게임이기도 했지만, 기존의 방식과는 다른 참신함 때문이었다. 어디서 만든 건지, 게임 한번 잘 만들었다.
294|
295|“궁금해서 그래요. 내가 들은 소문이랑 같은지. 뭐 하루 이틀도 아닌데 기분 나쁘고 자시고가 있나.”
296|
297|“……뭐 그렇다면야.”
298|
299|물었군. 나는 내심 흐뭇하게 웃었다. 이제 본격적으로 정보를 캐낼 일만 남았다.
300|
301|“첫 번째. 내가 누군지 알아요?”
302|
303|아까보다 더 괴상해진 질문이었지만 월화는 순순히 대답했다. 이 상황을 즐기는 것 같기도 했다.
304|
305|“올해로 약관이 된 태원진가의 막내 도련님. 이름까지 알려 드릴 필요는 없겠죠?”
306|
307|나는 자신 있게 대답했다.
308|
309|“압니다. 진태경.”
310|
311|제 이름은 진태경. 태원진가의 막내죠.
312|
313|내 자신만만한 대답을 들은 월화는 연기를 내뱉다 말고 사레가 들렸다.
314|
315|“두 번째. 태원진가는 어떤 곳입니까?”
316|
317|간신히 기침을 멈춘 월화가 대답했다.
318|
319|“세간의 평판이 좋아요. 이따금 마적 떼 토벌도 하고, 가뭄이 오면 관아보다 먼저 구휼미를 풀기도 하니까.”
320|
321|이게 끝?
322|
323|내 실망을 알아차리기라도 한 것처럼 월화의 말이 이어졌다.
324|
325|“무엇보다 산서성을 대표하는 명가(名家)죠. 뿌리 깊은 거목이랄까.”
326|
327|“오오!”
328|
329|나도 모르게 탄성을 터트렸다. 태원진가의 대단함에 감동한 게 아니라, 시스템 알림 때문이다.
330|
331|띠링.
332|
333|
334|
335|- [태원진가]에 대한 정보를 수집했습니다.
336|
337|- 칭호, [명가의 자제]를 얻었습니다. 추후 상태창을 통해 확인할 수 있습니다.
338|
339|
340|
341|‘칭호? 명가의 자제?’
342|
343|판타지 장르 게임에서의 타이틀 같은 건가 보다.
344|
345|‘드래곤 슬레이어라든지. 뭐 그런 거.’
346|
347|일정 업적을 달성하면 주어지고, 타이틀을 장착하면 부가 효과가 따라붙는다. 그런 면에서 나 같은 경우에는 상당히 운이 좋다고 할 수 있겠다.
348|
349|‘이거 완전히 금수저 캐릭터잖아.’
350|
351|명문가에서 태어난 것 자체가 업적이라니. 열받으면서도 기쁘다. 제멋대로 선택된 랜덤 캐릭터가 로또였다는 말이니까. 그러나 이야기는 거기서 끝이 아니었다.
352|
353|“하지만 요즘은 안팎으로 문제가 있다고 들었어요.”
354|
355|“문제? 무슨 문제요?”
356|

- Semantic fidelity outranks elegance. Never improve rhythm, humor, or localization by changing a physical action, negation, relationship, hierarchy, mechanism, quantity, or causal detail.
- Preserve every fact, causal link, joke, emotional beat, repetition, and intentional omission. Add nothing.
- Preserve small action verbs and pragmatic cues exactly: nodding versus shaking one's head, pretending nothing happened, and mild or approachable impressions are characterization, not expendable texture.
- Preserve viewpoint and tense. Resolve omitted subjects only when context supports it; retain genuine ambiguity.
- Match each speaker's hierarchy, intimacy, humor, and profanity naturally. Do not mechanically retain every honorific or classical self-reference.
- Do not censor or soften content.

## Terminology

- `compendium.md` and `docs/NAMES.md` are binding for established names, titles, ranks, techniques, organizations, system terms, items, and locations. Profile headings and aliases join that ledger.
- Search only exact Korean terms already present in the current chapter; the compendium contains future-sensitive entries.
- Never re-romanize established names or invent grand names for uncertain terms. First use of an unlisted name or title almost always needs a footnote or a mapped ledger term.

- Use contemporary US English and natural action-comedy prose; avoid Korean syntax calques and generic cultivation MTL phrasing.
- File: `translations/NNNN.md`; heading: `# Chapter N`.
- Speech: curly double quotes. Direct thoughts: italics without quotes.
- Use em dashes without spaces, the ellipsis character `…`, and `* * *` for source scene breaks.
- Format each actual game System-message panel as one Markdown blockquote window headed `> **System**`. Keep all consecutive notices, fields, and lines inside that same blockquote; separate windows when prose intervenes. Do not enclose System notices or UI terms in square brackets; the `System` heading and framed blockquote identify the panel. Do not label manuals, ordinary quotations, warnings printed in a manual, or other non-System material as `System`; use a normal blockquote or a specific heading instead. Do not wrap each complete notice in outer `**`; retain bold only for meaningful labels or emphasis inside the panel.

*My name is Jin Taekyung. I’m the youngest son of the Jin Family of Taiyuan.*

[P123]
At my confident reply, Wolhwa choked in the middle of exhaling smoke.

[P124]
“Second. What kind of place is the Jin Family of Taiyuan?”

[P125]
After barely managing to stop coughing, Wolhwa answered.

[P126]
“They have a good reputation among the people. From time to time, they wipe out bands of mounted bandits, and when droughts come, they distribute relief grain before even the magistrate’s office does.”

[P127]
*That’s it?*

[P128]
As if she had noticed my disappointment, Wolhwa continued.

[P129]
“More than anything, they’re a prestigious family representing Shanxi Province. You could call them an old tree with deep roots.”

[P130]
“Oh!”

[P131]
I let out an involuntary exclamation—not because I was moved by the greatness of the Jin Family of Taiyuan, but because of the System notification.

[P132]
Ding.

[P133]
> **System**
>
> Information about the Jin Family of Taiyuan gathered.
>
> Title Scion of a Prestigious Family acquired. Check it later through the Status Window.

[P134]
*A title? Scion of a Prestigious Family?*

[P135]
I guessed it was something like a title in a fantasy game.

[P136]
*Dragon Slayer, or something like that.*

[P137]
You received one after accomplishing a certain feat, and equipping it granted additional effects. In that respect, I had to say I was pretty lucky.

[P138]
*This guy really was born with a silver spoon in his mouth.*

[P139]
Being born into a prestigious family counted as an achievement. It pissed me off and made me happy at the same time. That meant the random character selected against my will had turned out to be a lottery winner. But the story didn’t end there.

[P140]
“I’ve heard there are problems inside and outside the family these days.”

[P141]
“Problems? What kind of problems?”

[P142]
Come to think of it, the quest window’s information-gathering mission was still marked *Incomplete*. That meant there was more information to collect.

[P143]
“Externally, there’s the conflict with the Mount Heng Sword Sect, which is constantly eyeing the position of Alliance Leader in Shanxi Province. Internally…”

[P144]
Wolhwa leisurely tapped the ash from her pipe.

[P145]
“I hear that family’s third son is a notorious good-for-nothing.”

[P146]
“Ah. There’s always one of those wherever you go.”

[P147]
I nodded unconsciously, then was seized by a strange feeling.

[P148]
“Excuse me.”

[P149]
“Yes?”

[P150]
“I’m only asking as a joke, but how many sons does the Jin Family of Taiyuan have?”

[P151]
She answered with a sunny smile.

[P152]
“Three.”

[P153]
The Jin Family of Taiyuan had three sons, and I was the youngest of them. But the third son was a notorious good-for-nothing. Which meant—

[P154]
*Fuck. That’s me, isn’t it?*

[P155]
Ding.

[P156]
> **System**
>
> Title Shame of the Family acquired. Check it later through the Status Window.
>
> Gather Information complete.

[P157]
I couldn’t decide whether to laugh or cry. Then I saw Wolhwa quietly chuckling and let out a hollow laugh myself.

[P158]
*Fine. No point getting worked up. So what if I’m the shame of the family? It’s only a game, anyway.*

[P159]
I opened the quest window and confirmed that *Gather Information* had changed to *Complete*.

[P160]
*The problem is understanding the situation.*

[P161]
This damn quest was so vague that I had no idea what exactly it wanted. In the end, was Wolhwa my only solution?

[P162]
“Where are we?”

[P163]
“Honghwaru, the finest pleasure house in Shanxi. This is my room.”

[P164]
Through our conversation, I learned a few more miscellaneous facts.

[P165]
We were in Honghwaru, located in the heart of Taiyuan. Wolhwa was a fairly high-ranking courtesan, and she and I had spent the night… Ahem.

[P166]
Despite everything we discussed, no System notification appeared. Eventually, I ran out of questions to ask.

[P167]
At the very end, I was reduced to asking this:

[P168]
“What’s my situation right now?”

[P169]
Wolhwa sighed.

[P170]
“Young Master Jin, I’m sorry to say this, but you seem a little crazy right now. How about getting some rest?”

[P171]
*Yeah. I feel like I’m going crazy, too.*

[P172]
As sunlight streamed through the window, I began to wonder what on earth I was doing.

[P173]
*This isn’t some kind of mystery game.*

[P174]
The graphics and artificial intelligence were all great, but getting stuck on the tutorial had completely drained the fun out of it. If there was one thing I’d learned, it was that the capsule I’d found yesterday was a much better piece of equipment than it looked.

[P175]
A game this advanced had to require serious hardware, yet I hadn’t experienced a single bit of lag. It should sell for a decent price on the used market.

[P176]
*I need to start looking for a new job today, too.*

[P177]
Still, the game hadn’t been bad for the little while I’d played it.

[P178]
I said goodbye to Wolhwa with one last glance and shouted:

[P179]
“Log out!”

[P180]
> **System**
>
> Logout is impossible.

[P181]
*Huh?*

[P182]
“Log out.”

[P183]
> **System**
>
> Logout is impossible.

[P184]
*What’s going on?*

[P185]
An error? Or had the piece-of-junk capsule finally started lagging?

[P186]
“…Log out?”

[P187]
> **System**
>
> Logout is impossible.

[P188]
There was no doubt about it. Error or lag, the damn junk capsule had finally caused trouble. I tried ten more times after that, but every attempt failed.

[P189]
By this point, my anger had gradually turned into worry and regret.

[P190]
*Is something bad going to happen to me?*

[P191]
*I shouldn’t have picked it up just because it was free. I should have thrown it away the moment Jinho called it garbage. Or at least the moment I read that insane instruction manual…*

[P192]
*No. Wait.*

[P193]
The instruction manual. That was right—I’d read it. More precisely, I’d read a few of the warnings before tossing it aside, but I had read them.

[P194]
*What did they say?*

[P195]
The moment I finally remembered every warning I’d managed to read, a chill ran through my entire body.

[P196]
> **Warning**
>
> - The player cannot log out at will.
> - If the player dies during gameplay, resurrection is impossible.

[P197]
*I’m trapped inside the game? Me?*

[P198]
The System notification answered my question for me.

[P199]
Ding.

[P200]
> **System**
>
> Understand the Situation complete.
>
> Tutorial—Stage 1 complete. Rewards will be distributed.
>
> Status Window activated.
>
> Skill Window activated.
>
> Inventory activated.
>
> Chain Quest Tutorial—Stage 2 created.

[P201]
At that moment, a single thought filled my head.

[P202]
*I’m fucked.*

# Translation Rules

## Fidelity

- Translate the Korean source—not the wiki, manhwa, fan translations, or expected plot.
- Semantic fidelity outranks elegance. Never improve rhythm, humor, or localization by changing a physical action, negation, relationship, hierarchy, mechanism, quantity, or causal detail.

- Preserve small action verbs and pragmatic cues exactly: nodding versus shaking one's head, pretending nothing happened, and mild or approachable impressions are characterization, not expendable texture.
- Preserve viewpoint and tense. Resolve omitted subjects only when context supports it; retain genuine ambiguity.
- Match each speaker's hierarchy, intimacy, humor, and profanity naturally. Do not mechanically retain every honorific or classical self-reference.
- Do not censor or soften content.

## Terminology

- `compendium.md` and `docs/NAMES.md` are binding for established names, titles, ranks, techniques, organizations, system terms, items, and locations. Profile headings and aliases join that ledger.
- Search only exact Korean terms already present in the current chapter; the compendium contains future-sensitive entries.

## English and Markdown

- Use contemporary US English and natural action-comedy prose; avoid Korean syntax calques and generic cultivation MTL phrasing.
- File: `translations/NNNN.md`; heading: `# Chapter N`.
- Speech: curly double quotes. Direct thoughts: italics without quotes.
- Use em dashes without spaces, the ellipsis character `…`, and `* * *` for source scene breaks.
- Format each actual game System-message panel as one Markdown blockquote window headed `> **System**`. Keep all consecutive notices, fields, and lines inside that same blockquote; separate windows when prose intervenes. Do not enclose System notices or UI terms in square brackets; the `System` heading and framed blockquote identify the panel. Do not label manuals, ordinary quotations, warnings printed in a manual, or other non-System material as `System`; use a normal blockquote or a specific heading instead. Do not wrap each complete notice in outer `**`; retain bold only for meaningful labels or emphasis inside the panel.
- Keep the final file English-only reading copy: no audit notes, Korean text, summaries, or model metadata.

### Tone and Style

- Write like a polished commercial webnovel: brisk, vivid, accessible, and easy to read aloud.
- Preserve the series’ contrast between danger and comedy. Let absurdity, bad timing, blunt reactions, and grim situations create dark humor without adding jokes absent from the Korean.
- Jin Taekyung’s narration is conversational, observant, self-mocking, and occasionally profane. It may be irreverent even when the situation is serious.
- Keep deadpan punchlines short and well-timed. Do not explain a joke after delivering it.
- Preserve the source's level of explicitness. A euphemism may remain euphemistic even when its meaning is sexual or crude; do not replace it with more graphic English merely for impact.
- Make dialogue spontaneous and character-specific. Preserve hierarchy and intimacy through word choice, address, rhythm, and restraint—not archaic wuxia English.
- Use strong profanity when the Korean is strong, but neither intensify nor sanitize it. Do not make ordinary lines uniformly vulgar. Profanity should reveal mood or relationship.
- Keep action and injury vivid but clear rather than purple. Do not make violence funny unless the source’s framing does.
- Avoid stiff literalism, translator-added melodrama, dated internet slang, and quippy superhero-style banter.

[P130]
“Oh!”

[P131]

[P132]
Ding.

[P133]
> **System**
>
> Information about the Jin Family of Taiyuan gathered.
>
> Title Scion of a Prestigious Family acquired. Check it later through the Status Window.

[P134]
*A title? Scion of a Prestigious Family?*

[P135]
I guessed it was something like a title in a fantasy game.

[P136]
*Dragon Slayer, or something like that.*

[P137]
You received one after accomplishing a certain feat, and equipping it granted additional effects. In that respect, I had to say I was pretty lucky.

[P138]
*This guy really was born with a silver spoon in his mouth.*

[P139]
Being born into a prestigious family counted as an achievement. It pissed me off and made me happy at the same time. That meant the random character selected against my will had turned out to be a lottery winner. But the story didn’t end there.

[P140]
“I’ve heard there are problems inside and outside the family these days.”

[P141]
“Problems? What kind of problems?”

[P142]
Come to think of it, the quest window’s information-gathering mission was still marked *Incomplete*. That meant there was more information to collect.

[P143]
“Externally, there’s the conflict with the Mount Heng Sword Sect, which is constantly eyeing the position of Alliance Leader in Shanxi Province. Internally…”

[P144]
Wolhwa leisurely tapped the ash from her pipe.

[P145]
“I hear that family’s third son is a notorious good-for-nothing.”

[P146]
“Ah. There’s always one of those wherever you go.”

[P147]
I nodded unconsciously, then was seized by a strange feeling.

[P148]
“Excuse me.”

[P149]
“Yes?”

[P150]
“I’m only asking as a joke, but how many sons does the Jin Family of Taiyuan have?”

[P151]
She answered with a sunny smile.

[P152]
“Three.”

[P153]
The Jin Family of Taiyuan had three sons, and I was the youngest of them. But the third son was a notorious good-for-nothing. Which meant—

[P154]
*Fuck. That’s me, isn’t it?*

[P155]
Ding.

[P156]
> **System**
>
> Title Shame of the Family acquired. Check it later through the Status Window.
>
> Gather Information complete.

[P157]
I couldn’t decide whether to laugh or cry. Then I saw Wolhwa quietly chuckling and let out a hollow laugh myself.

[P158]
*Fine. No point getting worked up. So what if I’m the shame of the family? It’s only a game, anyway.*

[P159]
I opened the quest window and confirmed that *Gather Information* had changed to *Complete*.

[P160]
*The problem is understanding the situation.*

[P161]
This damn quest was so vague that I had no idea what exactly it wanted. In the end, was Wolhwa my only solution?

[P162]
“Where are we?”

[P163]
“Honghwaru, the finest pleasure house in Shanxi. This is my room.”

[P164]
Through our conversation, I learned a few more miscellaneous facts.

[P165]
We were in Honghwaru, located in the heart of Taiyuan. Wolhwa was a fairly high-ranking courtesan, and she and I had spent the night… Ahem.

[P166]
Despite everything we discussed, no System notification appeared. Eventually, I ran out of questions to ask.

[P167]
At the very end, I was reduced to asking this:

[P168]
“What’s my situation right now?”

[P169]
Wolhwa sighed.

[P170]
“Young Master Jin, I’m sorry to say this, but you seem a little crazy right now. How about getting some rest?”

[P171]
*Yeah. I feel like I’m going crazy, too.*

[P172]
As sunlight streamed through the window, I began to wonder what on earth I was doing.

[P173]
*This isn’t some kind of mystery game.*

[P174]
The graphics and artificial intelligence were all great, but getting stuck on the tutorial had completely drained the fun out of it. If there was one thing I’d learned, it was that the capsule I’d found yesterday was a much better piece of equipment than it looked.

[P175]
A game this advanced had to require serious hardware, yet I hadn’t experienced a single bit of lag. It should sell for a decent price on the used market.

[P176]
*I need to start looking for a new job today, too.*

[P177]
Still, the game hadn’t been bad for the little while I’d played it.

[P178]
I said goodbye to Wolhwa with one last glance and shouted:

[P179]
“Log out!”

[P180]
> **System**
>
> Logout is impossible.

[P181]
*Huh?*

[P182]
“Log out.”

[P183]
> **System**
>
> Logout is impossible.

[P184]
*What’s going on?*

[P185]
An error? Or had the piece-of-junk capsule finally started lagging?

[P186]
“…Log out?”

[P187]
> **System**
>
> Logout is impossible.

[P188]
There was no doubt about it. Error or lag, the damn junk capsule had finally caused trouble. I tried ten more times after that, but every attempt failed.

[P189]
By this point, my anger had gradually turned into worry and regret.

[P190]
*Is something bad going to happen to me?*

[P191]
*I shouldn’t have picked it up just because it was free. I should have thrown it away the moment Jinho called it garbage. Or at least the moment I read that insane instruction manual…*

[P192]
*No. Wait.*

[P193]
The instruction manual. That was right—I’d read it. More precisely, I’d read a few of the warnings before tossing it aside, but I had read them.

[P194]
*What did they say?*

[P195]
The moment I finally remembered every warning I’d managed to read, a chill ran through my entire body.

[P196]
> **Warning**
>

> - If the player dies during gameplay, resurrection is impossible.

[P197]
*I’m trapped inside the game? Me?*

[P198]
The System notification answered my question for me.

[P199]
Ding.

[P200]
> **System**

> Understand the Situation complete.
>
> Tutorial—Stage 1 complete. Rewards will be distributed.
>
> Status Window activated.
>
> Skill Window activated.
>
> Inventory activated.
>
> Chain Quest Tutorial—Stage 2 created.

[P201]
At that moment, a single thought filled my head.

[P202]
*I’m fucked.*

- Translate the Korean source—not the wiki, manhwa, fan translations, or expected plot.

- Match each speaker's hierarchy, intimacy, humor, and profanity naturally. Do not mechanically retain every honorific or classical self-reference.
- Do not censor or soften content.

## Terminology

- `compendium.md` and `docs/NAMES.md` are binding for established names, titles, ranks, techniques, organizations, system terms, items, and locations. Profile headings and aliases join that ledger.

## English and Markdown

- Use contemporary US English and natural action-comedy prose; avoid Korean syntax calques and generic cultivation MTL phrasing.
- File: `translations/NNNN.md`; heading: `# Chapter N`.
- Speech: curly double quotes. Direct thoughts: italics without quotes.

- Format each actual game System-message panel as one Markdown blockquote window headed `> **System**`. Keep all consecutive notices, fields, and lines inside that same blockquote; separate windows when prose intervenes. Do not enclose System notices or UI terms in square brackets; the `System` heading and framed blockquote identify the panel. Do not label manuals, ordinary quotations, warnings printed in a manual, or other non-System material as `System`; use a normal blockquote or a specific heading instead. Do not wrap each complete notice in outer `**`; retain bold only for meaningful labels or emphasis inside the panel.

### Tone and Style

- Write like a polished commercial webnovel: brisk, vivid, accessible, and easy to read aloud.
- Preserve the series’ contrast between danger and comedy. Let absurdity, bad timing, blunt reactions, and grim situations create dark humor without adding jokes absent from the Korean.
